column1: Site: http://192.168.130.54/new-steve/  ·  Tested: 2026-11-19 (black-box, as a shopper; no source code access)
Edit the Status, Assigned To and Dev Notes columns (yellow header cells) as fixes progress.

column5: Add product to cart > Checkout > fill guest details > Delivery Info shows "No home-delivery rate is available… Please choose pickup or contact the store." No pickup option is shown. "Continue to Payment" reloads with "No delivery option is available for this address." Tried Alameda CA, New York NY, Houston TX, Toronto ON, Ahmedabad GJ.
column6: Configure shipping zones/rates in admin and enable store pickup; show pickup option when no rate exists.

column5: Review endpoint returns 401 for guests and requires a purchase of the product (403 otherwise). Because checkout is blocked, no one can buy, so every product shows "Reviews (0)".
column6: Fix checkout first; optionally allow reviews from verified-email buyers.

column5: /search?make=Toyota (no year): 134 s. /search?year=2015 (no make): 28 s. Year+Make+Model: about 4 s. Measured with no other load on the server.
column6: Add DB indexes on fitment year/make/model; optimise or cache the query.

column4: Countries without state/city data cannot check out
column5: Country = Hong Kong: states API and cities API both return empty lists, but City is required. Server returns "The city field is required."
column6: Fall back to a free-text City (and State) input when the list is empty.

column4: Every page is about 20 MB of HTML
column5: Full category tree (about 21,000 categories with counts; about 15,600 have 0 products) is rendered into every page. Search pages are about 33 MB. Homepage time-to-first-byte about 2.9 s, search about 3.5 s. With about 20 concurrent requests, pages took about 30 s.
column6: Load the mega menu via AJAX or cache it; hide categories with 0 products; paginate the tree.

column5: Button links to /shop (root-relative), which drops the /new-steve/ prefix. /new-steve/shop also returns 404.
column6: Point the button to the search/shop route using the app URL helper (url()/route()).

column5: /api/vehicles/years returns 2022 down to 1943. No 2023–2026 model years.

column4: Foreign-language duplicates and poor product titles in results
column5: Search "oxygen sensor" returns "Bonde pour sonde d’oxygène", "Junta para Sensor de Oxígeno". Some titles are codes/descriptions, e.g. "4SB-2MPGSO", "Cast Aluminum, Reverse Rotation (W/2 Seals, Gasket)".
column6: Filter products by language; clean product titles during import.

column5: GET /compare/add?product_id=99999999 returns "Product added to compare list!" and increments the count.
column6: Validate that the product exists before adding.

column5: Cart update with quantity 25 when stock is 20 sets quantity 20 but the UI toast says "Cart updated successfully!".
column6: Show "Only 20 available" when the requested quantity is reduced.

column4: Login requires accepting Terms on every sign-in
column5: Login without ticking the terms box fails: "Please agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions to sign in."
column6: Require Terms acceptance only at registration.

column4: Common URLs return 404; no order tracking page
column5: 404: /login, /register, /shop, /about, /contact, /track-order, /terms-and-conditions. Real pages: /users/login, /users/registration, /about-us, /contact-us, /terms-conditions. These 404 URLs are not linked from the site.
column6: Add redirects for common URLs; add an order-tracking page.
